verified_semantics: AArch64 syntax accepted with Android clang target aarch64-linux-android34 and armv8.2-a.
The candidate initializes both local buffer mutexes, selects timeout values and forwards them to flash-access setup.
Bootloader version gating, write-block rounding, MTP read helper arguments and exact-length copy are preserved.
The candidate does not set the update flag at tcm+0x388, matching stock read-side assembly.
Firmware-mode switching and ordered cleanup of returned data followed by setup allocation are preserved.

devm_kfree of the returned MTP buffer and setup allocation requires canonical ownership and teardown review.
